test_cases.description: Legacy path renders correctly for non-selected user
Pi shadow path does not leak to UI for selected user
Terminal event fires exactly once per request
No duplicate assistant messages in UI
No duplicate tool cards in UI
Error state renders correctly when Pi fails (fallback to legacy)
Loading state transitions correctly
Multi-turn context preserved across turns for selected user
Multi-turn context preserved for non-selected user
SSE stream correctly closed after terminal event
Reconnect after network interruption does not duplicate output
after_event_id replay does not re-render already-rendered events
Cancel mid-stream cleans up correctly
Concurrent sessions in same browser do not interfere
Post-restart (T2): bucket assignment stable; same user gets same path
Concurrency burst (T5): all selected users get correct response, no mix
75% selected cohort remains UI-isolated (no Pi leakage to UI)
25% non-selected cohort does not attempt Pi path
50%→75% promotion does not duplicate active conversation output
Rollback 75%→50% (v9) does not expose stale Pi result
